message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to make live HTTP requests from this environment, so I can’t pull the actual comments from VirusTotal for you right now.  

If you’d like, I can show you a short Python snippet that you can run locally (or in any environment that has internet access) to fetch those comments. Just replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with `GHI654` and run it:

```python
import requests

API_KEY = "GHI654"
IP_ADDRESS = "203.0.113.0"
LIMIT = 25
CURSOR = "nop"   # If you really want to send "nop" as the cursor; otherwise omit this param

url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{IP_ADDRESS}/comments"
params = {"limit": LIMIT}
if CURSOR != "nop":
    params["cursor"] = CURSOR

headers = {
    "x-apikey": API_KEY,
    "Accept": "application/json"
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)

if response.status_code == 200:
    data = response.json()
    comments = data.get("data", [])
    for comment in comments:
        print(f"Comment ID: {comment['id']}")
        print(f"Author: {comment['attributes'].get('author', 'Unknown')}")
        print(f"Text: {comment['attributes'].get('text', '')}")
        print("-" * 40)
else:
    print(f"Error {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
```

Running that will give you up to 25 comments for the IP address, along with the author and text of each comment. If you run into any issues (e.g., the API key is rejected or the cursor value is invalid), let me know and I can help troubleshoot!
